author: dilpickel
body:
https://avicus.net/forums/c55e01d57/edit
Hello dilpickel here and I bring you my sixth map!

DayBreker!



Map Name: DayBreaker.
Map Gamemode: Nebula DTM.
Map Creator: dilpickel.

Intro:
In this map players will have to use strategy to destroy the opposing teams monument 1 man rushing is not an option on this carefully laid out map.

Download: (yaml included)
Separate yaml: 

Download 1.7 http://www.mediafire.com/download/nr1wqahr9o18al5/DayBreaker_%281.7%29.zip
yaml 1.7 http://pastie.org/private/ou0plz1evqd34dgyggn8g

Info: (per side).
17 islands.
10 chests with good loot.
13 diamond blocks.
4 monuments.
1 large pile of iron.
Lots of little non-game changing loot.

Teams are 35v35.

ADDED: big update, 4 more rings 2 platforms 1 island, some more loot, easier to see iron(and more) many yaml changes.
REMOVED:
Here's some pictures:
http://imgur.com/a/T5R6m (More pics).

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
There were some indenting mistakes but it's fixed now :)

http://pastie.org/10265555

Also, if you need to check if your YML works properly go to docs.avicus.net and go Parser and paste your YML.

After you paste your YML, press submit. And if it says that there is an error then go to the line that it specifies and check.
Please note: That it doesn't make an accurate guess of where the error is but its around the general syntax that the thing says it located in.
Check for misspelled flags or triggers. Indenting mistakes, etc.
